LinkedIn Summary Generator

Build a polished LinkedIn About section from your role, skills and achievements.

Your About section

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your current role and industry.
  2. Add years of experience, top skills and achievements.
  3. Pick a tone.
  4. Generate, review, and copy into LinkedIn.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does it work?

Enter your role, years of experience, skills and achievements — the tool assembles a first-person About section with a hook, story and CTA.

Which tones are available?

Professional, friendly or bold — each changes the voice of the generated summary.

How long is the summary?

The About section allows 2,600 characters; the generator keeps output well under that and shows the count.

How do I use the result?

Click Copy Summary and paste it into the About section of your LinkedIn profile.
